name: Bovard Auditorium
card_text: A USC performing-arts venue at 3551 Trousdale Parkway, with a hall dating to 1921.
tip: Use the outdoor 50-metre collection circle; entering the auditorium is not required.

name: Leavey Library
card_text: A USC library supporting undergraduate study. Check the official library page for current hours and access.
tip: Discover it from the public path outside; entering the library is not required.

name: Doheny Memorial Library
card_text: A campus library with book and journal collections, exhibitions and academic events.
tip: Collect from an accessible public path outside. Check USC Libraries before planning an indoor visit.

name: Alumni Park
card_text: The green space between Doheny Library and Bovard Auditorium, used for commencement and campus events.
tip: Stay on open public paths and respect temporary event closures.

name: McCarthy Quad
card_text: A green expanse between Doheny Memorial Library and Leavey Library.
tip: Use accessible public paths and avoid any areas closed for events.
